name: Solve applied mathematical optimization problems
description: Users requested the formulation or solution of applied mathematical optimization problems, covering domains such as linear programming, logistics, operations research, and resource allocation. Many queries involved defining decision variables, constraints, and objective functions for specific scenarios like production, transportation, or scheduling, while others sought algorithmic solutions for discrete or combinatorial problems.
